facts.text: I would like a book on taking care of your body and keeping your body healthy from back pain.
The book readers are educated men and women sensitive to back pain and youth.
The book readers include orthopedic specialists.
The book is intended for people who are very aware and sensitive about body care and rejuvenation.
The first chapter should introduce all subcategories of body care important for health and maintaining youth without back pain.
Chapters 2 to 10 should each be devoted to a fundamental aspect of back-pain-free body care.
The book should discuss topics relevant for common people, especially women.
The book should discuss people with various body physiologies.
The book should discuss people with chronic back pain.
The book should discuss young women and men.
The book should discuss beauty and body care professionals and other related people.
The book should be 300 pages and in A5 size.
The book is intended to be selected and awarded as a comprehensive, unique, complete reference on everything about skin care, youth, beauty, and skin health.
At the beginning of the book, the complete list of contents should be given including chapter titles, with an explanation of the paragraph for each chapter and the sections of each chapter.
The table of contents should include at least ten sections.
The contents of each chapter should be produced completely within the framework of the table of contents produced at the beginning of the book.
The contents should not repeat any subject and should be in a completely referable and valid technical language.
Where the answer stops, the writing should continue from the same stopping point.
All the text in the book should be produced so it will not be recognized as AI-generated text.
The tone of the text should be completely technical and academic.
Creativity and innovation should be used as much as possible in each part.
I want complete and comprehensive instructions without any defects if the requests are understood.
I provided a table of contents for the book including Dedication, Introduction, and Chapters One through Twenty, plus Jeremy’s Rules, Appendix, Acknowledgments, About the Authors, and Copyright.
